row: PTA+ Podcast | For Physical Therapist Assistants

PTA+ Podcast is a show made for Physical Therapist Assistants.

We talk about what PTA life actually looks like—school, first jobs, career growth, burnout, confidence, scope, and where this profession is going next.

No lectures. No fluff. Just real conversations with PTAs, educators, and leaders who understand the role and respect it.

🎧 New episodes weekly
💬 Honest conversations
💪 Built for PTAs at every stage

If you’re a Physical Therapist Assistant—or thinking about becoming one—you’re in the right place.
